$meta.why_this_matters: Tour operators and taxi services are the one category where the state publishes a canonical list. Everything below in 'official' sections comes from manipurtourism.gov.in, which makes it the highest-confidence data in this whole collection.

tour_operators.title: Manipur Association of Tour Operators (MATO) — full member list

taxi_services.title: Taxi operators listed by the Directorate of Tourism
taxi_services.caveat: The department publishes names and numbers only — no addresses, vehicle types or rates. Call each to build a fare card.

items.name: Classic Tours & Travels
items.notes: Also a MATO member — see above.

self_drive_rentals.name: Rent & Ride Imphal
self_drive_rentals.address: Thangjam Leirak Road, Thangapat Mapal, near IPC Club, Keirungbam Colony, Wangkhei, Imphal, Manipur 795008
self_drive_rentals.notes: The only self-drive operator found with a real Imphal address, a published fleet and published rates. Rates are as advertised on the operator's own site — confirm whether they include fuel, insurance excess and a security deposit before publishing them.

rejected_sources.note: These appear at the top of every 'bike rental Imphal' search but are national lead-generation directories, not Imphal businesses. None of them produced a verifiable local operator name, address or licence. Do not list them as partners or reproduce their advertised rates (e.g. '₹299/day', '₹899/day'), which are national teaser prices.

gaps: No two-wheeler / scooter rental operator in Imphal could be verified to a real local business. Every result was an aggregator. This needs on-the-ground sourcing.

No shared-Sumo or inter-district hill service operator found in any published source, despite this being how most people actually reach Ukhrul, Senapati, Tamenglong and Churachandpur. Contact the relevant operators' association in Imphal directly.

Boat operators on Loktak are not registered anywhere public. The homestays in stays.json (Maipakchao, Keibul, Budha Loktak) each arrange their own boats — route boat bookings through them rather than inventing a collective.
Manipur State Road Transport Corporation timetables and fares are not published online in any form found.
For tourist bungalow reservations the Directorate of Tourism gives a booking line of 0385-2421794 (the department's main number).
